title: [flaky test] YSQL table size tests (PgTableSizeTest and PggateTestTableSize)
body:
Jira Link: [DB-3396](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-3396)
### Description

[PggateTestTableSize.TestTableNotExists](https://detective-gcp.dev.yugabyte.com/stability/test?branch=master&build_type=all&class=PggateTestTableSize&fail_tag=all&name=TestTableNotExists&platform=linux)

Test was added recently (in https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/commit/2e767c443d80ac1144bfe75739dff84801f763b0) and failures are all in ASAN build so might be a real ASAN issue on the original diff rather than regression:

Same diff has a possibly independent issue [PgTableSizeTest.MaterializedViewSize](https://detective-gcp.dev.yugabyte.com/stability/test?branch=master&build_type=all&class=PgTableSizeTest&fail_tag=all&name=MaterializedViewSize&platform=all).
That looks like maybe just the test isn't waiting enough time for the size to be updated.
In any case, we should fix both of these to ensure the work from https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/commit/2e767c443d80ac1144bfe75739dff84801f763b0 works reliably.
